name: Person Identification Type 3 Code
definition: Specifies the type of person's identification.

ARNU.name: Alien Registration Number
ARNU.definition: Number assigned by a government agency to identify foreign nationals.

CCPT.name: Passport Number
CCPT.definition: Number assigned by a passport authority to a passport.

EMID.name: Employer Identification Number
EMID.definition: Number assigned to an employer by a registration authority.

DRLC.name: Drivers License Number
DRLC.definition: Number assigned by a license authority to a driver's license.

FINN.name: Foreign Investment Identity Number
FINN.definition: Number assigned to a foreign investor (other than the alien number).

TXID.name: Tax Identification Number
TXID.definition: Number assigned by a tax authority to an entity.
